chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 294 – Xiyue Finds Her Brother, Xuanji Sends a Loose Immortal Assassin
chapter_meta_description: Xiyue Commandery Princess discovers Ji Ning is her long-lost maternal uncle. Meanwhile, Ancestor Xuanji dispatches a dying Loose Immortal with a Reincarnation Edict to kill Ji Ning in the capital.
og_title: A Sister’s Silent Gaze, an Ancestor’s Deadly Favor
og_description: Xiyue watches her newfound brother from afar; Ancestor Xuanji trades a Reincarnation Edict for a desperate assassin’s strike.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s blood relative appears, and the Shaoyan clan sends a dying immortal on a suicide mission.
twitter_description: Xiyue sees her father’s face in Ji Ning. Ancestor Xuanji offers a Loose Immortal a golden ticket to reincarnation in exchange for one kill.

lore_anchors.definition: A decree issued by a Heavenly Dao–level power that compels even the Netherworld Kingdom to honor a guaranteed reincarnation, bypassing normal karmic judgment.
A cultivator whose body was destroyed during the Celestial Immortal tribulation but whose Primal soul survived; they live indefinitely but face increasingly deadly periodic tribulations.
The periodic ordeals that assail cultivators below the Celestial Immortal realm: a minor calamity every three hundred years and a major tribulation every nine hundred.
A soul-linked jade slip kept in a clan’s ancestral hall that shatters instantly when its owner dies, providing immediate confirmation of death.
A cultivator’s extended spiritual perception, allowing telepathic communication, remote detection, and—with special arts—mental attacks.
One of nine peaks at Heavenly Treasures Mountain headquarters where floating cloud seats allow guests to observe and bid on treasures during monthly assemblies.
